ideal: Every file in the company folder, on Mac or Windows, is read or named within ten seconds; agreements return as new files; nothing else changes.

quality: Every file read or named, never skipped; an approved agreement saved back as one new file; every other file byte for byte the same.
speed: A new or edited file is findable within 10 seconds, before a founder gives up on the task.
consumption: The sync uploads each changed document to R2 once, and nothing that did not change.
